answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to build a single, auditable history before it earns trust. Like onyx, that history should be hard and costly to forge, because every claim must link to real, checkable work for distinct peers. New identities start on a low knoll, with small limits and close review, and gain wider access only after consistent honest behavior. A bridge of peer endorsements then connects past work to future permission, so a thousand fake identities would need a thousand separate histories, stakes, and endorsements, while one honest agent needs only one.
